reviews.review: Requires Origin to even start. DRM infested by EA.
Won't even launch. the issue is with EA's Origin License Service. I cannot recommend this game on Steam until it's unlinked from Origin.

I genuinely don't think I could summarise just how much this game is. It's the end of what I'd consider objectively one of the best trilogies in all of gaming. It's an amazing game in its own right, and it's such a perfect sequel to what came before.

Mass Effect 3 symbolises the apex of the series, at least to me. The most refined gameplay, the best presentation and atmosphere by a golden mile, and the best beat-to-beat story, just winning out over ME1. It really does feel like the promise that Bioware put forth the 5 years prior to release: be the commander of a war-effort in a diverse, complex and vast galaxy. Its ties to earlier games are phenomenal, down to the most minute detail. That's as best as I can put it.

HOWEVER Yes, the endings feel a bit vapid compared to the rest of the game, with some especially confusing requirements for the 'best' options. Particularly a gripe I have is the near-required engagement of multiplayer to actually access all your war assets. I don't like multiplayer, and that's not why I play Mass Effect. Also the end of the game is a HUGE difficulty spike that had me just wanting each encounter to be over. I kinda knew going in the endgame was trash, but I really thought it could be redeemed or wasn't as bad as people said it was. Now I understand, even agree, with a fair amount of the hate it gets.

All in all however, this game, the entire trilogy, is absolutely worth a playthrough. I'd go as far to say as it's some of the best experiences in gaming history, a must-play maybe. Andromeda can suck my pp raw tho.

[b]Ye Olde Mass Effect fan here.[/b]

If you're like me and wanted to have ME3 in your Steam library to complete the trilogy and hopefully remove Origin from your life, you'll be disappointed. You NEED to have Origin installed in order for the game to launch. Currently there is no reason to buy this game again on Steam, especially not now that the Legendary Edition is out.

If, however, you bought it to return to the multiplayer as I had — you may notice that the game fails to launch entirely. If this happens, navigate to C:\ProgramData\Electronic Arts\EA Services\License and delete every file in the License folder. Restart your computer and then launch the game from Steam again.

AND QUICK REMINDER: 
This does not include the DLC bundle which is pretty much essential for the multiplayer experience as it includes platinum difficulty, additional map variations, etc. If you do not have the DLC expansions, you may find yourself waiting endlessly in matchmaking due to less players overall. The DLC bundle is currently set at £25 also.
The fact that you can't holster your weapon ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ baffles me to this day. Messy but still good.

I just finished playing this for the first time.  It took me this long because I was traumatized by Dragon Age 2.  BioWare being acquired by EA is one of the worst things that ever happened for us old, "classic" RPG gamers.  But now that I've finally played it, I'm glad I did.  I don't know why people were so upset about the ending(s).  I loved every moment of the storyline, even seeing the eventual conclusion(s) coming.  It was beautifully written.  And even though it plays even more like a shooter (not to mention a sloppy console port) than ME2, I was prepared for that; I knew that was the direction things were headed in, so I wasn't disappointed as much by it as I might have been if I'd played it when it first came out.

If you read this and haven't already bought the game, as much as I hate to say it, don't buy it here. EA decided not to update this game when they deleted Origin and due to that you can't launch this game anymore. Great game released by a careless company.

A fitting end to the heroic tale of Commander Shepard. If you play through the first and second games, you WILL CRY at the end of Mass Effect 3. Props ton BioWare for making me care about video game characters like no other game ever has. I feel as though they were real people, my real friends and my real family.

The Crew of the SSV Normandy will forever be in our hearts <3
